faq.title: Questions Before You Start
faq.description: Clear answers about setup, cost, image quality, privacy, and supported devices.

howItWorks.question: How does it work?
howItWorks.answer: Start with a photo, reference, or idea. Choose a preset or AI Mask, or open Studio and describe what you want. Before you create, the app shows the credit cost and whether a plan is required.

sourcePhotos.question: Is personal AI model training required?
sourcePhotos.answer: No. Use presets, AI Masks, and Studio with a photo or reference without training a personal model. Train one only when you want the same person to stay recognizable across repeated photos; this optional workflow uses 10–20 varied selfies and requires Pro or Max.

pricing.question: How much does it cost, and are there limits?
pricing.answer: One-time credits work for eligible 1K creation and editing. US reference packs are 200 credits for $5.99 or 300 for $8.99. Pro starts at $6.99 per week and adds 2K plus optional Standard training; Max starts at $29.99 per month and adds 4K plus optional Full training. Annual plans are billed in full and add credits monthly. Final localized offers vary by country and platform, and credits never expire.

subscriptions.question: How do I manage or cancel a subscription?
subscriptions.answer: Manage Apple subscriptions in your Apple Account, Google subscriptions in Google Play, and web subscriptions from billing settings or support. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. You keep unused credits and personal AI models you already trained.

imageQuality.question: What affects image quality?
imageQuality.answer: Results depend on your source photo or reference, the preset or AI Mask, the generation quality you choose, and your prompt. Use a clear, well-lit photo when a workflow asks for one, and compare multiple results if needed.

privacy.question: How are my photos and data handled?
privacy.answer: You choose whether generated photos are public or private. Photos stay in your account until you delete them, and you can permanently remove individual images or your full library. We do not sell your personal data.

platforms.question: Where can I use My AI Photo Shoot?
platforms.answer: Use it in a web browser or through the iOS and Android apps.

whyNotChatGPT.question: How is this different from a general AI image tool?
whyNotChatGPT.answer: My AI Photo Shoot brings guided presets, AI Masks, Studio, custom prompts, and a simple generation-quality control into one focused photo workflow.

directAnswer.title: Describe what you want. Auto Mode refines the prompt.
directAnswer.description: Auto Mode interprets and refines every Studio request. When you start with a photo, it also analyzes the image and uses the Generation quality selected in the app.

starts.title: Start with a photo or personal AI model
starts.description: Use a photo for a direct edit, or choose an optional personal AI model to create multiple images of the same person.

photo.title: Photo
photo.description: Choose a photo you have uploaded or one of your previous creations, then describe the change you want. Auto Mode analyzes the image before generation.
photo.choice: Best for one-off edits, transformations, reframing, and creative changes. No personal model needed.

personal.title: Personal AI model
personal.description: Choose a model trained on 10–20 of your selfies, then describe a new scene, outfit, pose, or style. Auto Mode refines your prompt for personal-model generation.
personal.choice: Best for creating many new photos while keeping the same person recognizable. Photos made with a personal model have their own workflow and credit price.

steps.title: Create a photo in three steps
steps.description: Choose a starting point, describe the result, then create and review your photo.

source.title: Choose a starting point
source.description: Select a photo, a previous creation, or an optional personal AI model.

describe.title: Describe the result
describe.description: Describe the change or new scene in your own words. You can also reuse a previous prompt, turn a photo into a prompt, or ask Studio to surprise you.

create.title: Create and review
create.description: When you start with a photo, Studio uses the Generation quality selected in the app. Create your photo, review the result, and download it when you are happy with it.

autoMode.title: Describe the result in your own words
autoMode.description: Auto Mode turns your request into clear generation instructions based on your starting point and goal.

photo.title: When you start with a photo
photo.description: Auto Mode analyzes the image, translates instructions when needed, determines what to change and preserve, and selects a supported aspect ratio and file format.

personal.title: When you use a personal AI model
personal.description: Auto Mode translates and refines your request for personal-model generation. It does not analyze a separate photo, and the Generation quality setting used for photos does not apply.

autoMode.control: Auto Mode refines the request. You still choose the Generation quality used for photo-based creation.

quality.title: How Generation quality works with a photo
quality.description: When you start with a photo, Studio uses the Generation quality selected in the app. Choose faster 1K generation to save time and credits, or choose 2K or 4K for more detail. Higher levels may require Pro or Max.

payg.title: Faster 1K generation
payg.description: Quick edits and everyday creations when speed and lower credit use matter most.

pro.title: Higher-quality 2K generation
pro.description: More detail for polished portraits, profile photos, and complex edits. Pro includes two 2K quality options.

max.title: Highest-quality 4K generation
max.description: The highest available resolution for detailed scenes and final images that benefit from extra clarity.

quality.note: These reference credit costs apply when you generate from a photo. The Generation quality control in the app shows the cost and plan required for each option. Credits never expire. Personal AI model generation has its own credit price.

personal.title: When to train a personal AI model
personal.description: Train a personal AI model when you want to create many different photos of the same person while keeping them recognizable. Training is optional—you can use Studio with a photo instead.

upload.title: Add 10–20 selfies
upload.description: Use clear solo photos with a few natural angles and expressions, and balanced lighting. The app checks that your photos are suitable before training.

train.title: Choose Standard or Max training
train.description: Standard training requires Pro. Max training requires Max and takes longer.

create.title: Use the model in Studio
create.description: Create new photos at the listed personal-model credit price. The model helps keep the same person recognizable across different prompts.

writing.question: Do I need to write a perfect prompt?
writing.answer: No. Describe what you want in your own words. Auto Mode interprets your request and refines the prompt before generation.

autoMode.question: Does Auto Mode choose my Generation quality?
autoMode.answer: No. Auto Mode refines the prompt. When you start with a photo, Studio uses the Generation quality selected in the app.

quality.question: Which generation quality should I choose?
quality.answer: Choose Faster when speed and lower credit use matter most. Move toward Higher quality for more detail or 2K and 4K output.

personal.question: Can I use Studio with a personal AI model?
personal.answer: Yes. Choose an existing personal AI model, then describe the new photo you want. Photos made with a personal model have their own workflow and credit price.

required.question: Do I need to train a personal AI model?
required.answer: No. You can use Studio with a photo. Train a personal model only when you want to create multiple photos of the same person.
